title: Microsoft Teams: building-level insights on the Teams Rooms Pro Management recommended actions page
summary: The briefing's rollout, default state, licence prerequisites and operational controls are supported by Microsoft's notice and documentation. A minor clarification should explain that Teams Shared Devices was renamed Teams Shared Space, rather than leave the naming difference unresolved.

claims.claim: Building-level insights are being added to the Recommended Actions page in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal.
claims.quote: IT gets new building level insights on the recommended actions page in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal.

claims.claim: The insights highlight buildings with high Teams Rooms usage and remaining BYOD rooms to help IT prioritise upgrades and improve room-to-room consistency.
claims.quote: This update helps IT admins identify buildings with high Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR) utilization that still have bring-your-own-device (BYOD) rooms in them, creating an inconsistent user experience from room to room.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The Recommended Actions Learn page does not yet describe the building-level view.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro Management building level insights recommended actions disable Meeting space optimization recommendations PowerShell API licensing; opened microsoftteams/rooms/recommended-actions in full; no building-level view description.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented the building-level high-utilisation threshold or its measurement period.
claims.quote: Searched: "building-level insights" "utilization" "threshold"; Teams Rooms Pro Management "building" "insights" disable utilization threshold missing building. Opened Recommended Actions; no building-level threshold or period found.

claims.claim: The Recommended Actions location hierarchy is sourced from the Microsoft Graph Places API v1 room resource.
claims.quote: The location hierarchy in the Shared Spaces Insights and Recommended Actions pages are sourced from the Places API (V1) room resource type in Microsoft Graph.

claims.where: controls[1].governs; What's changing; Why it matters; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Building name in the page's location hierarchy maps to the room building property and Set-Place Building parameter.
claims.quote:
| Location Hierarchy | Set-Place (cmdlet) | Room resource type (Graph API) |
| Building name | building | building |

claims.claim: Rooms hidden from the address book are excluded from Shared Spaces Insights and Recommended Actions.
claims.quote: Rooms that are hidden from the address book are not included in Shared Spaces Insights and Recommended Actions pages.

claims.claim: HiddenFromAddressListsEnabled must be false on the room resource account mailbox for inclusion.
claims.quote: Specifically, the “HiddenFromAddressListsEnabled” must be set to false for the room resource account mailbox for the room to be included.

claims.claim: Recommended Actions follows portal RBAC and displays rooms the signed-in user is authorised to view.
claims.quote: Recommended Actions adheres to role-based access controls in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal, displaying rooms the user is authorized to view.

claims.claim: Only tiles relevant to the tenant appear on the page.
claims.quote: Only tiles relevant to your tenant are shown on this page.

claims.claim: Meeting space optimization recommendations is a tenant-level setting.
claims.quote: This is a tenant-level setting that is turned off by default. Admins can enable or turn off this setting at any time.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: The Meeting space optimization recommendations setting is off by default.
claims.quote: This is a tenant-level setting that is turned off by default.

claims.claim: The setting allows Microsoft to use room, device and usage data for meeting-space optimisation recommendations.
claims.quote: an administrator with appropriate access must enable the setting that allows Microsoft to use your room, device, and usage data in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal for this purpose.

claims.claim: Teams Rooms Pro Manager, Global Administrator and Teams Administrator can enable or disable the setting.
claims.quote:
The following Teams Rooms Pro Management portal roles have the required access to enable or disable this setting in the portal:
- Teams Rooms Pro Manager
- Global Administrator
- Teams Administrator

claims.claim: The setting is at Teams Rooms Pro Management portal > Settings > General > Meeting space optimization recommendations.
claims.quote: In the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal, go to Settings > General > Meeting space optimization recommendations.

claims.claim: No API or automation for the Meeting space optimization recommendations setting is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: "Meeting space optimization recommendations" "API" PowerShell MicrosoftTeams Graph; site:learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoftteams "room" "recommendations". Opened Recommended Actions; results documented UI but no corresponding command or endpoint.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn does not confirm whether building-level insights depend on the Meeting space optimization recommendations setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro Management building level insights recommended actions disable Meeting space optimization recommendations PowerShell API licensing. Opened Recommended Actions in full; it describes optimisation tiles but not building-level insights or their dependency.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Room building data can be edited at Teams Rooms Pro Management portal > Planning > Inventory > room > General.
claims.quote:
Select Planning then Inventory in the left navigation pane.
Select a room from your inventory and go to the General tab to update details such as address, building, and floor.

claims.claim: Exchange PowerShell Set-Place -Identity <room mailbox> -Building <building name> updates a room's building metadata.
claims.quote:
Module: Exchange PowerShell
The Building parameter specifies the building name or building number that the room is in.
The Identity parameter specifies the room mailbox that you want to modify.

claims.claim: Learn requires Exchange Admin or Global Admin to create, edit or remove resource accounts.
claims.quote: To create, edit, or remove resource accounts in a Microsoft 365 tenant, high-level privileges are required. Specifically, the IT administrator must be assigned to either the Exchange Admin or Global Admin role to perform these actions.

claims.claim: Teams Rooms Pro Manager, Global Administrator and Teams Administrator can check setting enable/disable history at Settings > General > Log history.
claims.quote: Teams Rooms Pro Manager, Global Administrator, and Teams Administrator roles can check the log history under Settings > General > Log history to view when this setting was enabled or disabled.

claims.claim: End-of-support and end-of-certification recommendations do not require the optimisation setting to be on.
claims.quote: The end-of-support and end-of-certification recommendations are related to room health and Teams service and do not require this setting to be turned on.

claims.quote: No changes will occur to existing configurations, policies, or settings.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions

claims.claim: The cited sources use Shared Space, Shared Device and Teams Shared Devices names, leaving the naming difference unresolved in the briefing.
